finding: missing portable-container parent detection and owner-inventory recovery
behavior: contained item records that reference a missing parent instance are reported as MISSING_CONTAINER_PARENT
corpse-held item records that reference a missing or cleaned-up corpse are reported as MISSING_CORPSE_PARENT
an explicitly invoked reconciliation may recover an orphaned contained item to its authoritative owner's carried inventory
the recovered instance identity, quantity, charges, durability, and canonical definition remain unchanged
recovery provenance records the missing container identity and owner_inventory policy
ownerless orphaned contained items and missing-corpse items fail closed
assumptions: an existing nonempty OwnerId is authoritative enough to identify the only safe recovery destination
equipment restoration is not inferred during orphan recovery
safe_fallback: throw InvalidDataException and preserve the authoritative file whenever no authoritative owner exists or the repaired state fails validation
runtime_impact: enables deterministic opt-in repair of missing portable-container parent references without discarding item state
character_save_impact: recovered items become carried and unequipped by the already-recorded owner
world_state_impact: removes only the broken parent reference and records recovery provenance; missing corpse references are never auto-repaired
